messages:
Mina (PM): Hey team — dropping the latest PRD excerpt for the Redwood API changes: rerank endpoint + embeddings stability gating. Need quick feedback on acceptance criteria, edge cases, and rollout gating. Link: https://redwood-internal/drive/prd/rerank-embeddings-v2 (please skim).

Raj (Eng): skimmed. main concerns: latency SLO impact from extra scoring loop and cold KV-cache warmups. we should call out p50/p95 targets and a budget for CPU/GPU extra tokens. also confirm batching interactions with streaming (we may need non-streaming path for synchronous rerank).

Olivia (ML Eng): on evaluation side I propose: maintain golden prompts set (~200 prompts across verticals), compute MRR and nDCG@10 pre/post, and block on >1.5% absolute drop or >3% relative drop in nDCG. also track embedding cosine drift per-customer.

Mina (PM): copy. draft ACs below — please push edits/filter.
```
AC-1: API compatibility: existing chat/completions calls must not change default response shape unless `rerank=true` or `rerank_mode` provided.
AC-2: Latency SLO: rerank end-to-end median < 400ms, p95 < 1.2s for 90% of traffic on Dedicated profile.
AC-3: Quality gating: no >1.5% absolute drop in nDCG@10 on golden set; MRR change <= 1% absolute.
AC-4: Failure modes: if rerank backend is unavailable or exceeds budget, fallback to pre-rerank ordering with a routed metric for visibility.
AC-5: Cost control: per-request cost increase must be <2.5x baseline on avg; recommend an opt-in tier for cost-sensitive customers.
AC-6: SDK & docs updated: example calls + migration notes.
```

Raj (Eng): +1 to ACs. small edits: change p95 to <1.5s on Hosted tier and leave Dedicated stricter. also we need an explicit throttling policy when throughput spikes (circuit-breaker). add: `x-rerank-variant` header for routing.

Ava (SDK): adding `rerank_mode` param is fine. propose values: `none|standard|strict|approx`. need backwards compatibility test and ensure OpenAPI spec bump note. also update streaming section: when `rerank_mode!=none` we return a final scores object after stream close (so streaming clients don't get partial reorderings).

Olivia (ML Eng): edge cases to call out:
- very short candidate lists (<=2): rerank should be no-op.
- identical scores from model: deterministic tie-breaker needed (timestamp or stable id).
- embeddings missing for a candidate: fallback to lexical signal.

Sam (ProdOps): rollout plan:
- canary 2% traffic for 12h, monitor errors and latency.
- ramp to 10% for 24h if stable.
- ramp to 50% and run A/B eval (golden set checks) for 48h.
- full roll if quality gates pass and infra metrics OK.
- automatic rollback triggers: error rate increase >0.4pp, latency p95 increase >30% over baseline, or nDCG drop >1.5% on the golden set.

Mina (PM): for customer-driven asks: Shopify-like retailer asked for deterministic sort when `fairness_tag` present and ability to weight recency. propose an optional `rerank_weights` bag-of-weights (numeric) in request; restrict to whitelisted accounts initially. thoughts?

Raj (Eng): technically doable but expands API surface. prefer implement via `metadata` blob that we map server-side, plus a max-weights-size check. whitelist + rate-limit is safe.

Olivia (ML Eng): we'll need to include those weights in eval harness and ensure no catastrophic quality drops on other signals. suggest simulation mode off by default.

Ava (SDK): will add examples for `metadata` blob. ensure schema validation on server returns 400 for malformed weights.

Mina (PM): QA checklist idea:
- unit + integration tests for tie-breaker logic
- golden-set regression tests in CI (block merges if fail)
- smoke suite for Hosted/Dedicated latency profile
- SDK compatibility matrix tests

Raj (Eng): implementation notes:
```
- add separate rerank worker pool (configurable size) to avoid blocking general tokens pipeline
- prefetch candidate embeddings from cache and fall back to on-demand compute with timeout 300ms
- scoring function must be deterministic & seeded
- instrument token/cost accounting at request scope
```

Olivia (ML Eng): metrics to add to console: nDCG, MRR, embedding drift histogram, rerank-fallback-rate, per-customer nDCG delta. also flag evaluations with cohort labels.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary job created: job_id=canary/rerank/v2/1799502468, will run on deployment.

Mina (PM): great feedback — I'll update PRD + ACs and post a final pass for sign-off tomorrow. if anyone has strong objections to gating numbers above, say now. otherwise I'll merge after edits. :thumbsup:

Raj (Eng): no objections. ack.

Ava (SDK): ack, will prepare OpenAPI diff.

Olivia (ML Eng): ack, will add eval scripts and start golden-set baseline run.

Sam (ProdOps): noted, will wire alerts and rollback playbook.

Mina (PM): thanks — closing thread once PRD updated.
